title: Autopsy and Inheritance
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Noor Brightwater, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
